import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the provided CSV and select London's daily temperatures.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')
london = df.loc[df['city'].eq('London'), ['date', 'temp_c']].copy()

# Exclude the coldest day, retaining all other dated observations.
coldest_idx = london['temp_c'].idxmin()
london = london.drop(index=coldest_idx).sort_values('date')

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5))
ax.plot(london['date'], london['temp_c'], marker='o')
ax.set_title("London Temperature (Coldest Day Excluded)")
ax.set_xlabel('Date')
ax.set_ylabel('Temperature (°C)')
ax.set_ylim(0, london['temp_c'].max() + 1)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
fig.autofmt_xdate()
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
